svg.text: THE ANXIETY DISORDERS: WHAT IS THE FEAR ATTACHED TO?
They look alike from outside. The object of the fear is what separates them, and what decides the treatment.

g.text: Attached to everything, and it moves.
Money, children, illness, the future.
Worry most days for months, with
tension, poor sleep and fatigue.
Attached to the body's own alarm.
Peaks in minutes. Feels like dying.
The real disorder is the fear of the
next attack, which shrinks the life.
Attached to one specific thing or
situation: needles, snakes, crowds.
Avoidance relieves it today and
strengthens it for tomorrow.
Attached to an intrusive thought the
person knows is her own and hates.
The ritual lowers the distress for an
hour, so the ritual grows.
Avoidance works. That is the problem. Every escape proves to the brain that the danger was real and that
escaping saved you, so the fear is rewarded and returns larger. Treatment reverses this, gradually and with consent.
Before diagnosing anxiety, exclude the physical causes that imitate it exactly:
thyrotoxicosis, hypoglycaemia, anaemia, arrhythmia, asthma, and salbutamol, caffeine or tramadol withdrawal.
